title: Omnichannel Social Commerce SaaS SleekFlow Raises $8M Series A Led by Tiger Global
summary: On Jun 23, 2022, HK-founded omnichannel social-commerce SaaS SleekFlow (2019) closed an $8M Series A led by Tiger Global, with Transcend Capital and AEF Greater Bay (Gobi GBA) — for UK/Europe expansion, SEA push, and tech to connect FB/IG/TikTok shopfronts. Catalog + pay links

html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 29, 2022

On Jun 23, 2022, HK-founded omnichannel social-commerce SaaS SleekFlow (2019) closed an $8M Series A led by Tiger Global, with Transcend Capital and AEF Greater Bay (Gobi GBA) — for UK/Europe expansion, SEA push, and tech to connect FB/IG/TikTok shopfronts. Catalog + pay links inside messaging; unify chat/comments/live; 2,500+ integrations (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce); first in-chat one-click pay; 3→60 staff, rev ×5 YoY, Singapore SEA HQ; 5,000+ enterprise clients.

— END —
